name: MilanMetroStatus.it
description:
Never get stranded underground again.  

Get instant, real-time status updates for all Milan metro lines M1, M2, M3, M4, and M5. Whether there's a delay, a service disruption, or everything's running smoothly, this connector gives you a clear and immediate picture before you step onto the platform.  

Simply ask things like: 
- Is the M2 running normally right now?
 - Are there any disruptions on the Milan metro today? 
- What's the status of all lines?

Perfect for daily commuters, tourists, and anyone navigating Milan's underground network. Stay informed, save time, and travel smarter.  

Metro status data is sourced directly from public feed, so you're always getting information straight from the source.  

This connector is developed by an independent developer and is not an official ATM Milano product. Always verify critical travel information directly with ATM Milano or official sources before making travel decisions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MilanMetroStatus.it to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MilanMetroStatus.it to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-prod-v1.milanmetrostatus.it/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is MilanMetroStatus.it MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 4, 2026, MilanMetroStatus.it scores 93/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MilanMetroStatus.it MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MilanMetroStatus.it provides these MCP tools: get-metro-status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MilanMetroStatus.it?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MilanMetroStatus.it in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.
MilanMetroStatus.it does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
MilanMetroStatus.it is developed by Salvatore Cordiano. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
